غَرْفَةٌ A single act of taking [or lading out] water with the hand [as with a ladle: and in like manner also with a ladle: see 1, first sentence]. (S, * Mgh, * Msb, * K.) ＝
-A2- And A single act of cutting, or cutting off, a thing: or of clipping the forelock of a horse. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
